title: Exact-derived transport of a sheaf square through constant towers
statement: With specified derived-category models for the sheaf categories (Hom universe u+1) and tower categories (Hom universe u+2), for exact additive functors F between the abelian sheaf categories of Y and X and P between their tower categories, a specified isomorphism F ⋙ constant X ≅ constant Y ⋙ P transports a sheaf-level degree-one derived square to the corresponding tower-level square. The ordinary endpoint maps s and t must equal the constant images of z and a after the specified isomorphism. The conclusion includes the canonical derived single and shift comparisons, without assuming any endpoint invertible.

proof.text: Realize the source derived arrow as an Ext class using Ext.homEquiv. Apply exact-functor Ext compatibility to both composite functors and the specified isomorphism. Naturality under ordinary source precomposition and shifted target postcomposition transports the assumed sheaf square. The two endpoint identities identify the resulting endpoints with s and t. Cancel the inverse single comparison to obtain the precise displayed single and shift comparisons. Prove these calculations first for four arbitrary abelian categories, then specialize to the named sheaf and tower categories with their published derived-category instances. The endpoint maps are named with objectwise derived source types before specializing the objects; their bodies remain exactly the canonical single and shift comparison composites.

theorem constant_tower_derived_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [hDiagY : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb Y)]
    [hDiagX : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb X)]
    [hAbY : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Ab Y)]
    [hAbX : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Ab X)]
    (F : DiagonalAb Y ⥤ DiagonalAb X)
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (P : Ab Y ⥤ Ab X)
    [P.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (τ : F ⋙ constant X ≅ constant Y ⋙ P)
    {A B : DiagonalAb Y} {A' B' : DiagonalAb X}
    (z : F.obj A ⟶ A') (a : F.obj B ⟶ B')
    (s : P.obj ((constant Y).obj A) ⟶ (constant X).obj A')
    (t : P.obj ((constant Y).obj B) ⟶ (constant X).obj B')
    (hs : s = τ.inv.app A ≫ (constant X).map z)
    (ht : τ.hom.app B ≫ t = (constant X).map a)
    (h : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb Y) 0).obj A ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb Y) 0).obj B)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (h' : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).obj A' ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).obj B')⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hh : mapSingleArrow F 1 h ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map a)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map z ≫ h') :
    P.mapDerivedCategory.map (mapSingleArrow (constant Y) 1 h) ≫
        derivedShiftedSingleEndpoint P t =
      derivedSingleEndpoint P s ≫ mapSingleArrow (constant X) 1 h'
